author: Riilo
body:
Age: 14

Timezone: AEST

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION



Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?
I have been staff before on very tiny servers, that didn’t get a lot of players. Never been staff on well-known servers.

 

What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?
My biggest weakness is leadership, although I am very good at working with various kinds of people in a team. I don’t think it would affect my moderating as I can handle situations without having leadership, which probably doesn’t make sense.

What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?
A leader must be a role model to the lower positions. They must be able to do things for themselves, and not rely on others. They also must be able to speak up, be honest and not be shy to say things. Like mentioned above, my weakness is leadership, so I wouldn’t call myself a leader but I can work well with others.

 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
A main attribute of mine is my activity. I know a lot of players are active, but on weekends I can get on at any time in the day, especially moderating the Australian time zone. I also can deal with situations very well as I am very patient, and I like helping people out.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
Skills you should have include maturity, patience and being a role model. These skills are necessary when dealing with certain situations for example appeals and general questions. If these skills are lacking then you can be very unhelpful in a lot of ways. I believe I have these skills.

 

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?
Fairness – If a moderator is being unfair/biased, then it causes a lot of hate to that mod, and pushes them away from the server.
Activity – When moderating it isn’t a task to be inactive with. Banning one hacker, and not coming on for like 5 days, then repeating that 100 times is quite stupid.
Maturity – If you are being immature when moderating, it reflects badly on the mod, and the staff team. People don’t want to come online to have a moderator just messing around and not doing their job.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? It really depends if the moderator is doing it intentionally or unintentionally. If the moderator is doing it continuously intentionally then I’d report it to a higher staff. If they don’t know that what they’re doing, for example, they are a new moderator, then I would tell them as a heads up.



You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? Although it is in the nightclub, I would start verbally warning if it gets too out of hand. If they start being racial and disrespectful more than necessary, then I would step in. I wouldn’t go straight for a temp ban but I would calm the situation down.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would ask the staff member to delete it straight away. It doesn’t matter if it’s not very important, if its hidden from the community for a reason, then it doesn’t matter how important it is. If they keep doing it after I told them to delete it, I would screenshot their message and report it to higher staff.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? Considering the seniors don’t mean any harm, I assume it would be easy to make them stop. I would tell them that community members are getting annoyed by it, and hopefully, they would stop. If they don’t and they are the highest staff on the server, there is not much I can do about it.




CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.




Why do you want to be a moderator?

I simply want to be moderator, for helping out. The Australian time zone can be dead sometimes, but even if there are 5-10 players online, there could always be a hacker. Currently, there are 3 staff members that live in Australia/New Zealand. Obviously, they aren’t going to be on all the time, so I thought having an extra Australian mod would help out a lot.

What does Avicus mean to you?
I have left many times and returned. I have been on this server for over 3 years. I have over 2 and ½ of play time. I don’t want Avicus to die, I love the community and the game modes very much.

 

Anything specific the staff team could do better?

There aren’t many things I could name off the top of my head, just advertising is a main priority.

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

Like mentioned above, the Australian/British time zone doesn’t always have mods in it, so I just thought an extra one would help out a lot and would save some Americans staying up to 5 AM to moderate it.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
I just want to be deeply considered, as I am not as immature as what I was. I want to help as much as possible, so I thought this rank would do that. If I get denied for immaturity fair enough, I’ll just apply next time.
